idea: rea-video breaks a video into shots, says how each one was made, and returns a remake plan.

claims.text: rea-video takes any video and tells you shot by shot how the visuals, text, editing and audio were made.
It handles live footage, AI video, avatars, 3D, code motion and mixed edits, judging each shot and reassembling it on the original timeline.
Every shot gets evidence, a reverse-engineered prompt, and the captions, cuts and beats the edit was built on.
The output is a remake plan split into what to film, what to generate and what to code.
